meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把对话压缩成交接文档,让下一个智能体顺利接手。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在多个智能体之间接力完成任务。
copy.tagline_en: Compress the conversation into a handoff doc for the next agent.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to hand off context between agents in a multi-step task.

howto.what: 装上后,它能把当前对话压缩成一份交接文档,交给另一个助手接手。文档会存到系统临时目录,附有建议技能;密钥等敏感信息会被隐去,已有文件按路径引用,不重复抄。
howto.when: 当你要求把当前对话做成交接文档时触发;若顺带说明下一轮要做什么,会按此重点调整。

say.text: 把这次对话整理成一份交接文档
say.note: 文档会存到系统临时目录

say.text: 生成交接文档,下一轮重点看登录页设计
say.note: 会自动加入建议技能清单

say.text: 做交接文档时,记得隐去里面的API密钥

howto.what_en: Once active, Claude condenses the current conversation into a handoff document so another agent can continue. The doc is saved to the OS temp directory and includes a suggested-skills section; secrets and API keys are redacted, and existing artifacts are referenced by path instead of duplicated.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to turn the current conversation into a handoff document; optionally you can say what the next session should focus on and the summary is tailored to that.

say_en.text: Turn this conversation into a handoff document.
say_en.note: Saved to your OS temp directory.

say_en.text: Make a handoff doc; next session will focus on the login page design.
Create the handoff doc and redact any API keys in it.
